verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change remains correct and complete. `worker-prep.sh` refuses `claude-credentials-json` during initial format admission, before creating the worker tree or spooling the source credential, and `worker-live.sh` independently refuses it at the container-delivery seam. The Codex pre-flight has no original-document fallback: both refresh and skip paths derive minimal mount material, and the materialized file is checked unconditionally for refresh-shaped fields and the original refresh-token value. The added tests are substantive: they exercise the expired-token dry-run skip branch, prove the refused Anthropic fixture actually carries the durable sentinel, require an actionable refusal before any sentinel or mount material is written, retain a positive opaque-token control, and assert the launcher's exact non-dying credential-format set. I found no correctness, fail-closed, security, injection, or test-validity defect. Round 4 also had no findings, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
